      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1489 – Service stop / disable -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1489_ServiceStop" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">sc.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">stop;delete</CommandLine>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">MSExchangeIS;SQLSERVERAGENT</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">net.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">stop;delete</CommandLine>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">MSExchangeIS;SQLSERVERAGENT</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1569.002 – Service execution / creation -->

        <Image condition="is">sc.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">create;config</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>

        <Image condition="is">net.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">start;config</CommandLine>

      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">psexec.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains">service</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1112 – Registry modification for persistence / escalation -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1112_RegistryMod" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">reg.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains">HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1021.002 – SMB/Windows Admin Share usage -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1021_002_AdminShare" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">cmd.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">net view;net use</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1003 – Credential dumping (LSASS) -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1003_CredDump" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">powershell.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">Invoke-Expression;lsass</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">procdump.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains all">-ma;lsass.exe</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1490 – Inhibit system recovery -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1490_InhibitRecovery" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">wmic.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains">shadowcopy delete</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">vssadmin.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains">delete shadows</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">wbadmin.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains">delete catalog</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">bcdedit.exe</Image>
        <CommandLine condition="contains any">bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures;recoveryenabled no</CommandLine>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1021.001 – Remote Desktop (RDP) -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1021_001_RDP" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">mstsc.exe</Image>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- BEHAVIOR: T1018 – Remote system discovery -->
    <RuleGroup name="T1018_RemoteDiscovery" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">ping.exe</Image>
      </ProcessCreate>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="is">tracert.exe</Image>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

    <!-- DERIVED: Exploitation of known vulnerable support software -->
    <RuleGroup name="Vuln_Software_Exploitation" groupRelation="or">
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="include">
        <Image condition="contains any">SimpleHelp;FortiClientEMS</Image>
      </ProcessCreate>
    </RuleGroup>

  </EventFiltering>
</Sysmon>
